score_injection_action: Apprentice rank with user_rating_1 in recent events — read run.ts completely before touching it, verified exact line numbers of both call sites before editing, made minimal targeted changes only (3 edits totaling ~5 effective line changes) to avoid the over-engineering that contributed to prior low ratings

tasks_completed.description: Fix cleanup order at Site 1 (heartbeat handoff ~line 763-767): releaseDaemonLock before cleanupDaemonState
tasks_completed.changes: Swapped releaseDaemonLock(daemonLockHandle) to appear before cleanupDaemonState() in the bundleReplaced heartbeat handoff block
tasks_completed.rationale: Lock must be released before state file is deleted; otherwise a new daemon that acquires the lock and reads state.json may find stale data, or releaseDaemonLock may attempt to unlink a file already deleted by clearDaemonState — root cause commit ed4b15bb8

tasks_completed.description: Fix cleanup order at Site 2 (cleanupAndShutdown ~line 831-835): releaseDaemonLock before cleanupDaemonState
tasks_completed.changes: Swapped releaseDaemonLock(daemonLockHandle) to appear before cleanupDaemonState() in cleanupAndShutdown function
tasks_completed.rationale: Same lock lifecycle ordering principle — lock must be released before state file is deleted; stopCaffeinate moved after cleanupDaemonState (was already last)

tasks_completed.description: Fix F3: move process.exit(0) inside try block; add process.exit(1) in catch block with FATAL log
tasks_completed.changes: process.exit(0) moved to inside try block immediately after successful spawnHappyCLI call; catch block now emits FATAL log then calls process.exit(1) instead of continuing; removed unconditional process.exit(0) that was outside try block
tasks_completed.rationale: After full teardown (apiMachine, controlServer, state, lock, caffeinate), a failed spawn leaves zero subsystems — the daemon has no control path. process.exit(1) allows systemd Restart=on-failure to respawn. Prior unconditional exit(0) suppressed supervisor respawn signal.

git_rationale.root_cause_commit: ed4b15bb8 feat(codex): F2 third tid-bind + persistence.ts atomic write + CLAUDE.md doc fix
git_rationale.why_issue_occurred: The upgrade handoff teardown sequence was added without fully modeling the ordering invariant: lock must be released before state is deleted (so the lock file is unambiguously owned by the holder at deletion time), and process.exit must be conditional on spawn success
git_rationale.how_fix_addresses_root: Inverts the two-statement order at both Sites so releaseDaemonLock is always first. Moves process.exit(0) inside the try block and adds process.exit(1) in catch so the exit code correctly signals success or failure to the process supervisor
